name: satisfaction-assertion-published-interface
description: In a library, an assertion whose interface is published API and whose concrete type is published API too is not reported, because it states to every importer a promise of the published API, while the interface itself, which only its own package names, stays a certain candidate for unexporting under the complete consumer set. An assertion on an unexported interface and on an exported interface of an internal tree is certain, an assertion whose interface a loaded consumer names as a type is a use and is not reported, under a consumer set declared complete, and the method of the unexported interface that no call site invokes through it is reported, because an unexported interface restricts no implementor outside its package.
